Name: (CP) Statue of the Wizard
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=3]You can easily set the warp destination in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] settings.
You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]DebugMode[/url] to check the map name and coordinates, and change the warp destination freely by yourself.

The appearance of the statue can be changed.
The conditions for sending mail with item attachments can also be changed.[/size]

[size=3]If you have any problems or requests, please go to the POSTS page.[/size]

[size=3]Currently, English and Japanese and French translation files are included.[/size]
